reviewEvidence: Inspected pinned upstream commit 057d6117b9ab31747ede3a5684a009cb6079ad11 via GitHub API. The upstream public/models/manifest.json states: 'Orca Slicer generates all core calibration tests in-slicer, so no models are bundled or required.' No .3mf model files exist at this commit. All four calibration methods (temperatureTower, flowStandard, pressureAdvanceTower, flowCoarse) are OrcaSlicer built-in in-slicer generators. They are backend-generated by the PrintFarmer server via OrcaSlicer; no user-provided local model file is required. No fabricated checksums have been added.
